summary: Batch the remaining fresh runtime projection schema DDL to reduce durable sync waits during cold startup

replay.detail: No claim replay or projection rules change.

schema.detail: Tables, indexes, triggers and schema version are unchanged.

rules.detail: WAL and synchronous=FULL, identity, signing, readiness and request budgets retain their settings.

compatibility.detail: Fresh stores commit resources, custom projections, agent messages, coordination, glass heads, directive notes and account limits DDL as one chunk. Populated stores retain the original per-statement installation. Backfills and optional registered view hooks keep their independent boundaries.

downtime.detail: Fresh startup performs fewer durable commits. Existing-store startup receives no sync reduction, and no deadline or retry changes.

recovery.detail: An error or crash in the fresh late runtime DDL chunk rolls it back while preserving earlier committed chunks and data. Populated-store upgrades retain completed statements.
